premise: Leo bets the returning booster will need help to land; it settles on the pad all by itself, so Leo unloads the supply pod.
inspiration: Aesop's 'Hercules and the Waggoner', turned: this time the one in trouble needs nobody's help — it was never in trouble at all.
lesson: Don't bet against someone who's been practising.
learning: Rocket boosters can fly back, land themselves on their legs and fly again.

en-US.title: The Bet
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo {man:live} checked the display on his wrist. {sfx:beep} {man:says} “Here it comes. Bet you it needs our help to land.” {woman:enter} Maya {woman:face happy} grinned. {woman:says} [playfully] “Bet it doesn't. Loser unloads the cargo.” Down came the {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} booster, tail first, engines glowing, straight for the landing pad. {canvas:dust 0.6 7s} Dust sprayed out and floated slowly down. {man:face surprised} [short pause] Leo held his breath. {booster:wobble} The booster rocked once… and stood quite still, on its own four legs. {booster:live} It lifted them a little and set them down again, as if it were checking its knees. {woman:hop x2} {woman:says} “Next week it'll fly again, good as new!” {man:face sad} [sighs] Just then the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to booster} supply pod set down beside it. {sfx:thud} {man:tint #FFB3C7} Leo looked at the pod. He looked at Maya. {man:face happy} {man:says} “Fine. But you're carrying the heavy crate.”

es-ES.title: La apuesta
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo {man:live} miró la pantalla de su muñeca. {sfx:beep} {man:says} «Ahí viene. Te apuesto a que necesita ayuda para aterrizar.» {woman:enter} Maya {woman:face happy} sonrió. {woman:says} [playfully] «Te apuesto a que no. Quien pierda, lo descarga todo.» Y bajó el {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} cohete propulsor, de cola, con los motores encendidos, derecho a la plataforma. {canvas:dust 0.6 7s} El polvo salió volando y volvió a caer muy despacio. {man:face surprised} [short pause] Leo contuvo la respiración. {booster:wobble} El cohete se balanceó una vez… y se quedó quieto, sobre sus cuatro patas. {booster:live} Las levantó un poquito y las volvió a apoyar, como quien se mira las rodillas. {woman:hop x2} {woman:says} «¡La semana que viene volverá a volar, como nuevo!» {man:face sad} [sighs] Justo entonces, la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to booster} cápsula de carga se posó a su lado. {sfx:thud} {man:tint #FFB3C7} Leo miró la cápsula. Miró a Maya. {man:face happy} {man:says} «Vale. Pero la caja pesada la llevas tú.»

beep.prompt: two short soft electronic beeps from a small wrist computer

thud.prompt: a soft, deep, muffled thud felt through the ground, as if heard through thick boots
